title: Evaluation of Large Language Models in Legal Applications: Challenges, Methods, and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Using a counterfactual annotation strategy to systematically alter legally irrelevant attributes (e.g., changing a defendant's gender from male to female or altering geographic origin) in judicial case facts to measure inconsistencies, systematic bias via regression analysis, and imbalanced inaccuracy in model outputs like sentencing decisions (highlighted via the JudiFair benchmark).
Surveying existing legal fairness benchmarks (such as FairLex) that evaluate model fairness and robustness across different jurisdictions, languages, and legally protected attributes.
